content: To conquer without arrogance and to yield without cowardice is the mark of the noble soul.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
explanation: Triumph tempts the foolish to gloat and posture; defeat tempts the cowardly to grovel or despair. The noble human navigates victory with magnanimous humility, and meets temporary surrender with unbent dignity and clear eyes. Be equal to every outcome.
practicalInsight: If you win a victory today, share the credit; if you lose a contest, hold your head high and study the lesson.
reflectionPrompt: How can you practice handling both victory and defeat with the identical posture of quiet nobility?
